notes: The prompt card under the scatter plot is squeezed to an empty ~30px grey sliver, so "What is the slope of the dashed line of best fit?" is never shown and the four bare numbers are unanswerable. The plot and slope itself are correct.

No prompt card renders at all in either mode, so "y = 2x + 7. Predict y when x = 11" is invisible and the question is unanswerable; the scatter plot also has no x-axis line or x tick labels, only y labels 16-28, so the points cannot be read.

Prompt is ungrammatical: "How many grade 6 who walked to school?" should be "How many grade 6 students walked to school?". The wrong-answer explanation "Row Grade 6 x col Walked = 16" uses a multiplication sign for a cell lookup and only restates the answer.

The wrong-answer explanation uses the unexplained set symbol in "Cell Kids n Has pet = 7" and ends with the redundant "Fraction: 7/13 = 7/13". In keypad mode the prompt never says simplest form, so on seeds where the cell/row pair is reducible a typed unsimplified fraction may be marked wrong.
